subject: Pilot budget corridor & procurement onramp — follow-up
messages:
From: Eli Navarro <eli.navarro@thermostat.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, FinanceOps <finance@thermostat.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap — Redwood pilot cost conversation (today)

Chloe / Redwood team — great demo this morning, thanks. Quick recap from our side and asks to help our procurement and finance folks evaluate: 

- Estimated monthly consumption: ~2M–8M tokens/month during a pilot (mostly short chat interactions, some batch embeddings). Peak days could spike to ~10M.
- Target unit economics we think are reasonable: $10–$15 per 1M tokens for pilot pricing (we know-$/1M is a common way you price).
- Procurement constraints: Finance requires a PO for any vendor >$50k/year and prefers Net30. If the pilot commitment can be capped below $75k total spend, they may accept a month-to-month invoice without a long-term contract.
- Compliance ask: can you surface SOC 2 and data retention policy (we attached the NDA as requested).

Attached: thermostat-pilot-cost-model.xlsx (rough usage profile), Signed-NDA.pdf.

Requested next steps: can you confirm a preliminary price band for the 2M–8M token range and confirm whether Redwood can accept a PO or invoice terms as noted above? Also, if you have a short summary of discount thresholds by commit (e.g., price at 1M/mo, 5M/mo, 10M/mo) that would help Finance.

Thanks — Eli
Eli Navarro
Head of Product
Thermostat AI

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Quick recap — Redwood pilot cost conversation (today)

Karthik / Vanessa — forwarding Eli's note. High level my take and proposed response to keep procurement moving: 

1) Pricing posture: for a non-committed pilot we can offer an introductory band of $14/1M tokens midline (no long-term commit). If Thermostat agrees to a short commit (3 months, target 6M tokens/month averaged) we can drop to $9/1M tokens and provide $10k in pilot credits to offset onboarding burn.

2) Procurement path: Redwood accepts PO + Net30. For accounts that want to avoid PO we can invoice month-to-month if expected spend is under $75k total over the pilot window; otherwise Finance requires a signed SOW/PO. We should flag this to Sales Ops for acceptance.

3) Compliance: I'll pull the SOC 2 summary and retention matrix — Vanessa, can you attach the latest SOC 2 summary and our retention doc?

4) Quick ask for Eli: clarify whether the 2M–8M estimate is steady-state or front-loaded (e.g., lots of spikes during onboarding). If they can sketch expected % of embedding vs. chat tokens that helps with kernel selection recommendations.

Proposed next steps I will send to Eli: price bands by commit and an explicit PO/invoice path with thresholds + links to SOC2 and the pricing matrix. Approve?

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick recap — Redwood pilot cost conversation (today)

Chloe — sounds right. A couple of clarifications from pricing: 

- Our standard published non-committed rate for this model family is $16/1M tokens. Intro band $14/1M is fine for a short-term pilot (one month).
- Discounted commit tiers (rough): 1–3M/mo -> $12/1M; 3–7M/mo -> $9/1M; 7M+ -> $7/1M. We can anchor the 3-month 6M/mo proposal at $9/1M with pilot credits applied on first invoice.
- PO path: Sales Ops requires PO + SOW for any prepaid/reserved commitment. For invoice-only pilots under $75k total, we can do Net30 month-to-month with standard SOC-2 attestation attached. Procurement lead time typically 10–18 business days for large POs.

Attaching: redwood-pricing-matrix-v2.pdf. If Finance pushes for escrow/longer terms we should loop Legal early.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Pricing & Packaging
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot budget corridor & procurement onramp — follow-up

Eli — thanks again for the conversation. Quick consolidated reply and concrete next steps so Finance/Procurement can move: 

Summary of pricing options (confirmed):
- No-commit pilot: $14 / 1M tokens (month-to-month invoicing).
- Small commit: 1–3M tokens/month -> $12 / 1M (3-month minimum recommended).
- Mid commit: 3–7M tokens/month -> $9 / 1M (3-month commitment).
- High commit: 7M+ tokens/month -> $7 / 1M (6+ month commitment).

Pilot credits: we will apply $10,000 in onboarding credits to the first invoice for a signed pilot SOW.

Procurement thresholds / billing path:
- If expected pilot spend <= $75,000 total over the pilot, Redwood can accept month-to-month Net30 invoices (no PO required).
- If expected pilot spend > $75,000, Finance will need a PO + SOW; typical PO lead time is ~10–18 business days.
- Redwood can accept PO; our billing contact for PO and invoicing: billing@redwood.com

Compliance: attaching SOC 2 summary and retention matrix here (see attached). We will also upload the same artifacts to the HubSpot deal record for Finance review: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/DEAL-7231

Requested confirmation from Thermostat:
1) Which pricing band are you targeting (no-commit / small / mid / high)?
2) Expected pilot duration and whether spikes (peak days) are likely in month 1.
3) Will Finance issue a PO if estimated pilot spend exceeds $75k?

Next actions: 
- If you confirm mid-commit (3–7M/mo) I'll draft a 3-month SOW and pricing appendix and route for signature.
- If you prefer month-to-month, we'll send the first invoice and apply the $10k credit once the pilot starts.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call to align procurement stakeholders if helpful.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
